about: The block Linked sessions gives to link a session on claude.ai, and the line it gives for a session on this Mac, for one ticket's answer at two addresses, with the link client's sha256 written @CLIENT_SHA256@; and the fixed sentences the block and the link client print, {host} the ADE's host. The page's case (ui/src/components/CloudLink.test.tsx) checks that the page gives exactly these, and writes this file with CLOUD_LINK_WRITE_VECTORS=1; the client's (tests/test_cloud_link.py) runs each block in a shell and checks that the link client prints the same sentences.
name: Planner
host_refused: A claude.ai environment whose network refuses {host} needs it allowed: in the environment's settings, under Network access, choose Limited and add {host} to Allowed domains, keeping Allow package managers ticked; a running session follows the change within about a minute.
client_changed: The link client the ADE served is not the one the page carries (its sha256 differs), so nothing was installed or run: take the block again from the page the ADE itself serves, which carries the client of its own release.
no_cryptography: This session's python3 cannot import cryptography, which the link client needs, so nothing was fetched, installed or run: install it for that python3 with pip, which Allow package managers lets through, then paste the block again.
block_waits: This block waits for that change: it tries again every 10 seconds while its ticket lives and goes on by itself once the host is let through, so nothing needs pasting again.
ticket_ended: The ADE's host, {host}, is still refused and the ticket has too little time left to link, so nothing was installed or run: make a new ticket in Linked sessions and paste its block.
